basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the joys of online gaming with my younger brother. We first bonded over 'Orcs Must Die 3' and have been on the lookout for more cooperative games. When I'm not gaming, I'm busy with my job at a tech startup where I focus on developing mobile applications. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the local food scene or hiking in the nearby trails. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, typically from 7 PM to 11 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas. I've honed my skills through various projects and my current role at a startup. I'm also self-taught in game development, which has fueled my interest in gaming communities.
